=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:166-170 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The documented `git merge --no-edit origin/<source>` command produces Git's default merge subject, not the required `[claude-asset-sync]` subject.
  WHY: Following the procedure verbatim breaks the documented commit-prefix contract.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:233-236 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: If `origin/HEAD` cannot be resolved, the hardcoded `main` fallback can make drift reporting silently miss changes in repositories with a different default branch.
  WHY: The hook probes `refs/remotes/origin/main` and returns without reporting drift when that ref does not exist.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:238-242 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When GNU `timeout` is unavailable, the `git fetch` used by `report_claude_assets_drift` has no enforced 15-second bound.
  WHY: A slow network or proxy can hang SessionStart indefinitely; severity disagreement: qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this NIT while the others rated it MAJOR, so the highest severity is used.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:168 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The documented `HEAD@{1}` reference may be unavailable, suppressing detection of a `.claude/settings.json` change after the merge.
  WHY: The settings-change warning is not produced when the reflog reference cannot be resolved; severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated this MAJOR while minimax_minimax-m3 rated it NIT, so the highest severity is used.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:Step 6 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The cited Step 6 `HEAD@{1}` reference may be unavailable, suppressing detection of a `.claude/settings.json` change after the merge.
  WHY: If the cited reference cannot be resolved, the documented warning about new hook wiring is suppressed.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:252 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `behind` count includes all commits between HEAD and upstream, not only commits affecting `.claude/` paths.
  WHY: The count can mislead operators when it does not match the relevant files listed in `files=`.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:46 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The asset-sync procedure can merge and push unexpected commits without an operator confirmation or shell-level guard that validates the resolved source ref.
  WHY: A stale or misread source ref can bring unrelated commits into the working branch and pollute the PR diff.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:242 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The hook fetches on every SessionStart, including fresh checkouts.
  WHY: The unconditional fetch adds startup latency.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:274 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The hook's implicit git fetch is performed during SessionStart without a per-repository kill switch.
  WHY: This can introduce unexpected network and I/O activity for long-lived branches.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The plan and plan-deviation log specify drift-log tests with full coverage of every error path, including the shallow-history fallback when `git merge-base` fails.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_session_start_claude_assets_drift.py
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `report_claude_assets_drift` has a shallow-history fallback at `session-start.sh:253-259`; all test fixtures use full-history `git clone`, and no test exercises the fallback or `behind=unknown` reporting path.
- requirement: The hook log is documented to report `.claude/settings.json` drift when it is the only changed path.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_session_start_claude_assets_drift.py
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `test_settings_change_is_reported_with_hooks` changes `.claude/hooks/guard.py` together with `.claude/settings.json`; no test covers the settings-only drift case.
- requirement: The asset-sync procedure must actually produce the documented `[claude-asset-sync] merge <source> for .claude/ guard updates` commit subject.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_claude_asset_sync_command.py
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The command-text test checks that the subject appears in the prose but does not execute the procedure in a scratch repository and inspect the resulting merge commit subject.
- requirement: The documented drift behavior must be tested when `origin/HEAD` is unset but `refs/remotes/origin/<default>` exists.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_session_start_claude_assets_drift.py
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `test_missing_default_ref_is_silent` removes `refs/remotes/origin/main` and uses a missing remote; no test covers an unset `origin/HEAD` with the actual default-branch ref present.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:166 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The documented command `git merge --no-edit origin/<source>` cannot produce the claimed subject `[claude-asset-sync] merge <source> for .claude/ guard updates`.
  WHY: Following the documented procedure produces Git's auto-generated merge message, breaking the commit-prefix contract.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The plan (Phase 1 step 5) and the plan-deviation log line both scope the drift-log tests to cover every error path in `report_claude_assets_drift`. The shallow-history fallback (`else: # Shallow history without a merge base: fall back to a two-dot diff.`) at line 253 of session-start.sh is a separately-gated branch that produces `behind=unknown` output, and it is reachable when `git merge-base` fails.
  Expected change site: tests/test_session_start_claude_assets_drift.py
  Evidence of absence: Every test fixture uses `git clone` (full history). The `scratch` fixture clones with full history at line 73; `test_offline_fetch_falls_back_to_the_existing_ref` fetches then breaks the remote URL; no test creates a shallow clone (e.g. `git clone --depth=1`) or otherwise causes `git merge-base` to fail. The `else` branch is never exercised. The `behind=unknown` output path has zero coverage.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Step 4 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The documented commit subject `[claude-asset-sync] merge <source> for .claude/ guard updates` is not produced by `git merge --no-edit`.
  WHY: The commit receives a default Git merge message instead of the required prefix.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:report_claude_assets_drift | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The script relies on GNU `timeout` for the `git fetch` bound; if GNU `timeout` is unavailable on the runner, `git fetch` runs indefinitely.
  WHY: A slow network or misbehaving proxy can hang Claude Code startup indefinitely.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Step 6 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `HEAD@{1}` reflog reference may be unavailable in CI or shallow-clone environments.
  WHY: Settings-change logging can be suppressed even if `settings.json` was updated during the merge.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "the shallow-history fallback ... is implemented and reachable when `git merge-base` fails".
  Expected change site: `tests/test_session_start_claude_assets_drift.py`
  Evidence of absence: The test suite uses `git clone` (full history), so the shallow-history fallback (`else: # Shallow history without a merge base: fall back to a two-dot diff.`) is never exercised. No test case is provided to simulate a `merge-base` failure.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:233-236 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `origin/HEAD` cannot be resolved, the function silently falls back to hardcoded `main`, which can miss drift in repositories whose default branch has another name.
  WHY: The upstream-ref check fails and the function returns without a drift line.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:166 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git merge --no-edit` uses Git's auto-generated default merge subject, not the documented `[claude-asset-sync]` subject.
  WHY: Downstream tooling that greps for the prefix will not identify the merge.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:238-242 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Without GNU `timeout`, the fetch runs without a time bound.
  WHY: A slow DNS response, captive portal, or misbehaving proxy can keep `git fetch` blocked indefinitely.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:168 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `HEAD@{1}` may be unavailable when the reflog is missing.
  WHY: The settings-change warning is silently suppressed.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh:252 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `behind` figure counts commits that do not touch `.claude/` paths.
  WHY: Operators can read the count as relevant asset drift even when it reflects unrelated commits.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:46 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The sync procedure can merge and push an unexpected source ref without operator confirmation or a shell-level guard.
  WHY: A misread or stale source ref can carry unrelated commits into the working branch and pollute the PR diff.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Phase 1 plan implementation step 5 lists "drift-log cases in `tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py`", extended by the plan-deviation log line in `docs/implement-plan/issue-4952-sync-claude-assets-at-session-start.md:50` that moves those cases to the new pytest file "with full coverage of every error path".
  Expected change site: `tests/test_session_start_claude_assets_drift.py`.
  Evidence of absence: The shallow-history fallback in `session-start.sh:253-259` (`else: # Shallow history without a merge base: fall back to a two-dot diff.`) is implemented and reachable when `git merge-base HEAD origin/<default>` fails, but no test in `test_session_start_claude_assets_drift.py` deletes the reflog and runs `git merge-base` against a fixture without a merge base. Every fixture in `scratch()` (lines 60-79) uses a full `git clone`, so the two-dot diff and the `behind=unknown` reporting path are never exercised.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
